从真实停机位开始，离港滑行可跳过。取得许可后手动进入、对正并起飞。正爬升 G 收: Start at a real stand; departure taxi may be skipped. Obtain clearance, line up and take off manually. Retract gear with G after positive climb; L for CL above 500 ft. Follow ND / FD to the cleared altitude and onto the outbound route. Cruise skips automatically after passing the last waypoint in order. If departure is not yet stable, maintain the outbound track until it is; you can also skip early once stable. Arrive from the origin city direction and follow navigation onto final. Arm I when prompted, configure, check and land manually. Vacate at low speed, then taxi to stand or skip the remaining taxi. AP1 is optional.
